bucket-check.leaves: a bucket outside the profile's sources may hold storage the site doesn't count

access-ingest.leaves: this scan's read recency misses the newest access logs

access-r2.leaves: this scan's read recency is as of the previous aggregate

publish-r2.leaves: the scan's served files aren't all on R2

interval-store.leaves: the interval store doesn't hold this scan

index-rows.leaves: the scan's index rows aren't all in D1

index-sync.leaves: the scan isn't listed on the site

over-time.leaves: new over-time groups not sealed: the size-over-time chart reads their scans one by one

dups.leaves: no duplicate-candidate report for this scan: /dups shows the newest earlier scan's

age-store.leaves: the age store doesn't hold this scan

retire.leaves: older scans' per-scan files not retired

non-live.leaves: non-live bytes not measured for this scan: its map's non-live line is short or absent

healthcheck.leaves: the site's health check failed for this scan: serving may be degraded

warm-cache.leaves: cache not pre-warmed: this scan's first views load cold

probe.leaves: the serving probe failed: some of this scan's views may not load

staged-card.leaves: the staged plan's Slack card stays at the scan before

gcp-cost.leaves: today's cloud cost snapshot not written

soft-delete.leaves: today's soft-delete reading not written: the site keeps the last one, dated

vm-pack.leaves: VM mode's pack not written: the VM serves the previous one until a later run writes it
